content.text:
I scrolled to the bottom of the page. Here's how it went.

**My pick:** Meitav, the "עוקב מדדי מניות" track (fund number 7867). I'm fairly sure, not totally. What decided it was the return: "25.86%" over 3 years and "17.25%" over 5 years. That's one of the biggest numbers on the whole page, and Meitav is a name I know from ads. The fee is "0.65%", which sounds like almost nothing. So I'd put the 30,000 there, and probably the few hundred a month too.

**What I looked at, in order:**
- **Top of the page.** The heading "כל המסלולים בכל החברות" and the "קופת גמל להשקעה 143" button, which was already picked. So it's the right page.
- **First thing I hesitated over.** It says "143 מסלולים של 12 חברות", way too many. Then a list of filter buttons like "עוקב מדד S&P 500" and "מניות". I didn't touch any of them.
- **Harel.** "מניות" with "24.04%" over 3 years got my attention. So did "עוקב מדד S&P 500" with 13.7%, since that's what my friends talk about. But it's half the number.
- **The rest.** Mor, Analyst, Meitav, Altshuler Shaham, Phoenix, Yelin Lapidot, Migdal, Clal, Menora, Infinity, Ayalon. I only looked at the track names and the big percent numbers.
- **Analyst.** "עוקב מדדים - גמיש" had "26.39%", a bit higher than Meitav. But I don't really know Analyst, so I went with Meitav.

**What I skipped:**
- The row of 12 product buttons at the top, and the "מה זה קופת גמל להשקעה" link.
- The search box.
- The small grey line at the very bottom about the return. I think it said something about "לפני דמי הניהול".
- The bottom menu ("חוקים וכללים" and the rest).

**What I didn't get:**
- "ההפקדה" with 0% next to it, under the fee. Is that a second fee?
- "חשיפה למניות ולמט"ח": two percents and a little ring in yellow and teal. I guessed it's how much is in shares and how much is in dollars. Meitav says 98% מניות and 4% מט"ח, but the S&P ones are 99% and 99%. No idea why they're different.
- "פחות מ־3 שנים" where a number should be. Maybe these are new tracks?
- "עוד לא דווח" with an orange "!" icon. It looked like a warning, so I steered away from those rows.
- Tags like "הלכה יהודית", "חדש", "עוקב מדדי אג"ח".
- "אג"ח", "כספי (שקלי)", "גמיש".

**What bothered me:**
- It's one huge table and nothing tells me which one is good. No recommendation, no button to open the fund, no "start here".
- Every company has 10–16 tracks with almost the same names, and they all look alike. I got bored around Phoenix and Yelin Lapidot, about halfway down. I only kept going because I had to pick something.
- All the fees are 0.5–0.7%. It doesn't tell me in shekels what I'd actually pay.
- I still don't know what the first step is to actually open it.
